meta.title: DogeGo | Much Faster Full Dogecoin Node
meta.description: DogeGo is an open-source Dogecoin full node in Go with a built-in web dashboard, auto-updates from GitHub, wallet backup reminders, BlockStep explorer, JSON-RPC, and binaries for every major platform.

hero.title: Much Faster Full Dogecoin Node
hero.lead: The first Dogecoin full node with post-quantum commitments, zstd compression, CGNAT-friendly relay, faster multi-peer IBD with auto dbcache, and a browser dashboard that checks for updates, nags you to back up your wallet, and ships operator docs inside the app.
hero.note: Beta: ready to try. Help us test and tune.

overview.title: Overview: operator metrics + search
overview.body: Node health KPIs with Chart.js sparklines, chain disk breakdown, and a top search bar for height, hash, txid, or address. GitHub auto-update banner when a release is newer than your build. The fixed sync dock shows connected vs stored bodies, assist pool, and IBD ETA.

blockstep.title: BlockStep: timeline from genesis to tip
blockstep.body: Scrub Dogecoin history from December 2013 to the synced tip. Open any block in the explorer, inspect coinbase and PQ OP_RETURN outputs, and jump eras with one click. BlockStep shares the same tx index that powers dashboard search.

mempool.title: Mempool policy you can inspect
mempool.body: See waiting transactions with feerate, standardness, and BIP125 RBF status. Package limits, min relay fee, and Full RBF match Core flag names in dogecoinconf.json. Live parity probes compare testmempoolaccept rows against Dogecoin Core when configured.

features.title: Features tab: capabilities & cert matrix
features.body: Live RPC capability manifest, OpenRPC at /api/openrpc.json, and operator cert probes (AuxPoW parity, mempool corpus, restart-resume, founder checks). Settings can test a side-by-side Core connection and cache results for 90 seconds.

console.title: Run from the terminal
console.lead: DogeGo is a single Go binary. Download from GitHub Releases or build from source, then start the node. The dashboard and JSON-RPC come up automatically.
console.step3Body: Browser at localhost:2013. First run opens the setup wizard.
console.note: P2P user-agent announces /DogeGo:0.1.0-beta/ on the network. Not Shibetoshi, not Core.

features.title: Built beyond Dogecoin Core
features.lead: DogeGo ships operator tooling, indexing, and modern network modes that Core never bundled, in one Go binary with a browser dashboard.

pq.title: Post-Quantum commitments
pq.body: First Dogecoin full node with Phase-1 PQ OP_RETURN carriers (FLC1, DIL2, RCG4). Send with automatic wallet commitments, verify via dogego_verifypqcommitment, and inspect in the explorer.

zstd.title: zstd block compression
zstd.body: Optional zstd on stored block bodies plus a bundled blk*.dat layout. Core keeps raw blocks uncompressed. DogeGo reports compression ratio and disk savings in the dashboard.

spv.title: Full node or SPV
spv.body: Run headers-first IBD with full validation, or switch to lightweight SPV (headers only) for minimal disk. Same binary, same wizard. Pick your profile on first run.

cgnat.title: CGNAT & Starlink relay
cgnat.body: P2P modes: classic, cgnat (outbound-only), or both. Up to 12 outbound peers relay blocks without inbound port forwarding, built for carrier NAT and Starlink.

testnet.title: Reboot testnet
testnet.body: Fresh testnet with addresses starting with T (for test). Real scrypt PoW like Core (RelaxedPoW off). Digishield min-difficulty helps solo mining when hashrate is low. Port 44556.

search.title: Search everything
search.body: Full tx index by default. Search height, block hash, txid, or address from the dashboard. Dogecoin is a public ledger, and DogeGo makes every entry easy to find.

dashboard.title: Web dashboard
dashboard.body: Loopback UI at :2013: KPI cards, auto-update banner, sync dock, mempool, analytics, embedded Docs, Features cert matrix, and the five-step setup wizard. No Qt install required.

rpc.title: 180+ JSON-RPC methods
rpc.body: Core-compatible HTTP JSON-RPC with cookie auth, ZMQ notifications, OpenRPC at /api/openrpc.json, and live capability flags in the Features tab.

wallet.title: Built-in HD wallet
wallet.body: Send, receive, and history with BIP44 HD wallet, PIN unlock, optional WebAuthn biometrics, coin control, fee hints, PSBT with BIP32 deriv paths, optional HWI external signer, and Core wallet.dat migration (probe + native BDB import, encrypted via passphrase).

autoupdate.title: Built-in auto-update
autoupdate.body: The node checks GitHub Releases on qlpqlp/dogego, dogeorg/dogego, and dogecoinfoundation/dogego (newest semver wins) daily. Overview, Settings, and system tray offer SHA256-verified download and install restart.

backup.title: Wallet backup reminders
backup.body: First-run setup requires downloading wallet.json before start. On Receive, a recurring banner reminds you to back up offline - dismiss for 30 days, or rotate HD keys with an guided sweep to a fresh wallet.

dgr.title: DogeGo relay CGNAT (DGR)
dgr.body: QUIC tunnel for peers behind carrier NAT. Wizard and Settings configure dogego_relay_cgnat roles (Off / Client / Operator), TLS cert pinning, relay DNS seeds, and live metrics on GET /api/dgr.

dual.title: Dual mainnet + testnet
dual.body: Run both networks from one data folder with the Mainnet + testnet wizard profile. Separate mainnet/ and testnet/ chain dirs, dual dashboards (:2013 / :2014), solo mining on testnet only.

bip152.title: BIP152 compact blocks
bip152.body: sendcmpct HB negotiation with up to three peers, cmpctblock announce/reconstruct, and getblocktxn fallback. Live probe at GET /api/core-bip152-probe.

mining.title: Miner ready (Core parity)
mining.body: getblocktemplate with Digishield NextBlockBits + BIP22 longpoll, createauxblock/submitauxblock for merge-mining, and reboot-testnet solo mining with mempool txs. Certified live via GET /api/core-mining-probe and dogego cert mining.

mempoolPolicy.title: Mempool relay policy
mempoolPolicy.body: Wizard and Settings expose Core-shaped flags: maxmempool, minrelaytxfee, incrementalrelayfee, package limits, Full RBF, datacarrier, and bare multisig - plus a 58-template offline admission corpus, PaysForRBF descendant fees, and submitpackage CPFP.

ibd.title: Parallel block download
ibd.body: Faster, more stable multi-peer IBD: block-assist workers, height striping, auto UTXO dbcache, and Core-style IBD focus so download stays productive through long syncs.

tray.title: System tray & notifications
tray.body: Optional tray icon: open dashboard, check/download/install updates with SHA256 verify, and native OS notifications when a new GitHub release is detected.

extensions.title: Modular extension platform
extensions.body: Install and enable catalog packages without changing Dogecoin consensus: zip or GitHub install, subprocess/wasm hosts, allowlisted permissions, optional wallet_rpc, and host-rendered UI panels. See the Extensions section for each official package.

segwit.title: SegWit ready
segwit.body: BIP141 interpreter, witness serialization, and weight/vsize helpers ship today, Core-aligned with Dogecoin Core. CLTV is already active. Softfork follows Core's schedule; see SEGWIT_STATUS.md for upgrade effects on nodes and miners.

extensions.title: Official extensions
extensions.lead: Optional catalog packages you install beside the node. They do not fork mainnet consensus. Install from Settings → Extensions or the GitHub catalog, then enable.
extensions.footnote: Author your own packages too. Docs: EXTENSIONS.md · catalog on GitHub.

zkl2.title: ZK Layer 2
zkl2.body: Submit and sync ZK proofs anchored to confirmed Dogecoin txs over the zkproof-v1 P2P overlay. No L1 consensus fork. Mainnet + testnet.

doginals.title: Doginals / DRC-20 L2
doginals.body: Index L1 Doginals/DRC-20 carriers, mint via allowlisted wallet RPC, and sync off-chain NFT/token metadata among peers (doginals-v1). Mainnet + testnet.

radiodoge.title: RadioDoge
radiodoge.body: Connect a Heltec V3 SoftAP device: broadcast signed txs over LoRa when offline, and relay inbound mesh txs into DogeGo with sendrawtransaction when online. Same HTTP API as Dogecoin Wallet RadioDoge support.

bbpow.title: BBPoW research
bbpow.body: Testnet-only research toward Bitcoin SHA-256 commitments as a Dogecoin security signal (not AuxPoW, not mainnet consensus). Proof verify RPC and dual-lane difficulty sketch.

fullnode.title: Full Dogecoin node - what DogeGo runs today
fullnode.lead: Headers-first IBD with parallel body download, auto dbcache, IBD optimize (default on), Go-native storage, Core-compatible JSON-RPC, and operator tooling in one binary. Mainnet consensus follows Dogecoin Core (no protocol forks).

sync.title: Chain sync & IBD
sync.body: Headers-first sync with parallel body download, auto dbcache, IBD optimize (default on), journal recovery, and a sync dock with recent download rate and assist pool metrics.

consensus.title: Validation & mempool
consensus.body: Block/header checks, AuxPoW CAuxPow parity, in-memory UTXO cache with snapshot replay, 58-template mempool admission corpus, BIP125 RBF (PaysForRBF), submitpackage CPFP, feefilter, savemempool/loadmempool.

p2p.title: P2P networking
p2p.body: classic / cgnat / both, UPnP/NAT-PMP, learned addr store, addnode, setban, multi-peer relay, DGR QUIC tunnel, BIP152 v1 compact blocks.

rpc.title: JSON-RPC & ZMQ
rpc.body: 180+ methods, cookie auth, getblocktemplate BIP22 + Digishield bits, mining/aux RPC (Core-parity cert), estimatesmartfee, ZMQ hash/raw block+tx notifications, OpenRPC and RPC cookbooks in Settings -> Tools.

wallet.title: Wallet & migration
wallet.body: BIP44 HD per network, wizard backup + optional encryptwallet, fill-to-target keypoolrefill, PSBT/HWI, Core wallet.dat import + pool replay, coin control, Tx Flight, and wallet.db scan index for fast history (auto-rescan when the index lags).

ops.title: Operator UX
ops.body: Five-step wizard with five profiles, preflight (firewall, ports, CGNAT, founder), OS autostart, GitHub auto-update, 17 live cert web probes (mining GBT/aux + PQ), embedded Docs, analytics Pebble sidecar, dogego cert offline / bip152-soak / operator gates.

extensions.title: Modular extensions
extensions.body: Catalog / zip install, subprocess and wasm hosts, runtime permission checks, host-rendered UI panels, and dynamic RPC dogego_ext_<id>_<method>. See Official extensions for ZK L2, Doginals, RadioDoge, and BBPoW.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.lead: Dogecoin Core-compatible Go full node. Mainnet consensus follows Core (no protocol forks). Sync, wallet migration, mining, RPC, and operator tooling ship today. Full checklist: DogeGo/ROADMAP.md.

done.p2p: CGNAT / classic / both, DGR relay phases 1-4, UPnP, multi-peer IBD, BIP152 v1 HB + offline soak cert, addrman buckets + slot indices + eclipse-pressure eviction
done.ibd: Headers-first body IBD, IBD optimize + auto dbcache, UTXO snapshot replay/quarantine, connect catch-up, stall recovery
done.consensus: Scrypt PoW, AuxPoW CAuxPow check, Milestone A differentials, 1059/1059 legacy script corpus, mainnet field evidence
done.store: Header segments, bundled+zstd raw blocks, UTXO cache crash quarantine/tmp purge, crash/corruption recovery suite
done.mempool: 58-template offline corpus, BIP125 RBF (PaysForRBF descendant conflict fees), submitpackage CPFP package feerate, package DAG property tests, live testmempoolaccept, 24/24 stateful reboottestnet map (offline)
done.rpc: 180+ JSON-RPC, OpenRPC, ZMQ, 17 live Features cert gates (mining GBT/aux + PQ), dogego cert offline / operator / pq / wallet-import / bip152-soak
done.wallet: BIP44 HD wallet, fill-to-target keypoolrefill, Core wallet.dat pool replay, encrypt/unlock, coin control, HWI signer_cmd + mocksigner e2e, OS autostart
done.mining: generatetoaddress, createauxblock/submitauxblock, getblocktemplate NextBlockBits + BIP22 longpoll, reboot-testnet solo miner with mempool txs; GET /api/core-mining-probe + dogego cert mining
done.ui: Wizard, BlockStep, Features matrix, GitHub auto-update, tray, local HTTPS, sync dock
done.pq: PQ OP_RETURN + carrier (RPC/web send; needs more soak testing)
done.extensions: Modular extensions catalog (wasm/subprocess) plus official ZK L2, Doginals, RadioDoge, and BBPoW packages
done.segwit: SegWit ready: BIP141 machinery Core-aligned (CLTV active)

care.title: Operator experience built in
care.lead: DogeGo is more than sync and RPC - the loopback dashboard includes everyday tooling Core never shipped in one place.

releases.title: Release notifications
releases.body: Daily update check against GitHub Releases on qlpqlp/dogego, dogeorg/dogego, and dogecoinfoundation/dogego (newest semver wins). CLI, tray, and web UI offer SHA256-verified download and install restart.

backup.title: Backup nudges every 30 days
backup.body: Receive tab shows a wallet backup banner until you download a copy or snooze for 30 days. Setup wizard blocks Save & start until backup is acknowledged when the wallet is enabled.

rotation.title: HD key rotation
rotation.body: One-click prepare -> sweep -> verify -> finalize flow moves your balance to a fresh BIP44 wallet and archives the old keys - with backup required first.

autostart.title: OS login autostart
autostart.body: Register at sign-in on Windows (Task Scheduler), Linux (systemd user), or macOS (LaunchAgent). Wizard and Features tab run the same probes as dogego cert autostart.

txflight.title: Tx Flight send bar
txflight.body: Animated progress when you send: signing, broadcast, mempool wait, and confirmation - with one-click jump to History or the block explorer.

i18n.title: Six dashboard languages
i18n.body: English, Deutsch, Français, Português, 日本語, and 中文 - wizard and dashboard share the same locale picker in the top bar.

pin.title: PIN & WebAuthn lock
pin.body: Optional 6-digit dashboard PIN on setup or in Settings. Pair with device biometrics (WebAuthn) to unlock Send and wallet views without retyping every time.

docs.title: Embedded Docs tab
docs.body: Operator runbooks, integration guides, and repo markdown rendered in-browser via GET /api/docs - no GitHub tab required while you tune the node.

cert.title: Live cert matrix
cert.body: Features tab exposes Core parity counts, OpenRPC at /api/openrpc.json, and seventeen live operator web gates (compare, mempool, mining GBT/aux, autostart, founder, BIP152, IBD convergence snapshot, runner readiness, end-to-end, and more).

syncdock.title: Fixed sync dock
syncdock.body: Core-style footer during IBD: connected vs stored bodies, assist pool, recent download rate, connect lag, ETA, and expandable live logs - always visible while you browse tabs.

firewall.title: Firewall & preflight
firewall.body: Setup wizard runs automatic checks for ports, CGNAT hints, and optional OS firewall rules. Copy-paste elevated commands appear on Overview when action is needed.

history.title: History that scales
history.body: Infinite-scroll transaction feed with server-side search and type filters, CSV export, UTXO-cache fast path for solo miners, and soft refresh that preserves scroll position.

extensions.title: Extensions catalog
extensions.body: Settings → Extensions installs packages from GitHub or zip. Enable what you need; wallet access only via authenticated allowlisted RPC when an extension opts in. Browse packages in Official extensions.

blockstep.title: BlockStep: explore Dogecoin the fun way
blockstep.lead: Because Dogecoin is a public ledger, every block and transaction should be easy to find. DogeGo indexes the chain and BlockStep turns it into an interactive timeline.
blockstep.listSearch: Search by height, hash, txid, or address from Overview or Explorer
blockstep.listTimeline: BlockStep timeline: scrub from genesis to tip, drill into any block
blockstep.listIndex: Flat indexes/tx/ index, not Core's chainstate layout
blockstep.listPq: PQ explorer panel: inspect post-quantum commitment scripts

wizard.title: Five-step setup wizard
wizard.lead: First run opens a guided wizard at /setup. Pick a profile, run automatic preflight checks, configure bundled+zstd storage, then save with optional PIN, OS autostart, and wallet backup.

panels.profileHint: Tap a card - each profile sets network, node mode, wallet, and P2P defaults.
panels.profileTryTestnetSub: Full node · wallet on · best for first run
panels.profileMainnetFullSub: Production Dogecoin · longer sync, full validation
panels.profileMainnetWalletSub: Send/Receive · optional 6-digit dashboard PIN on finish
panels.profileDualSub: Two nodes · wallet on both · mine on testnet
panels.advancedToggle: Show advanced options on later steps
panels.dataFoot: Peer left empty -> automatic DNS + addrman discovery.
panels.networkHint: Connectivity, firewall, UPnP, and automatic preflight before you sync.
panels.syncHint: Recommended defaults: bundled blk*.dat, zstd compression, compact tx index.
panels.syncEmbedTx: Embed full tx bytes in index
panels.syncFoot: Block sync workers: automatic (2-6 peers during IBD). Auto dbcache uses free RAM.
panels.finishHint: Dashboard security, OS autostart, wallet backup, and config summary.
panels.finishBackupBanner: Wallet backup required - download wallet.json before Save & start
panels.finishReview: testnet · full · P2P both · bundled+zstd · wallet on

list.i18n: Six UI languages (English, Deutsch, Français, 日本語, 中文, Português)
list.preflight: Automatic preflight - firewall, ports, CGNAT hints, founder checks on reboot testnet
list.backup: Wallet backup gate on finish; Receive tab reminds every 30 days until you download or dismiss
list.autostart: OS login autostart with dogego cert autostart parity probes
list.dual: Dual mainnet+testnet profile with shared datadir and separate RPC/dashboard ports
list.ibd: IBD optimize on by default; auto dbcache sizes UTXO RAM from free memory
list.mempool: Advanced mempool relay policy on finish (maxmempool, min relay, package limits, Full RBF)

list.dgr: DGR relay auto-configured when P2P mode is both or cgnat
list.tray: System tray, dogecoin:// link handler, and optional no-browser / no-webui flags

compare.title: Why operators choose DogeGo
compare.lead: DogeGo is beta. Run it, break things, report what needs tuning. It ships capabilities Core does not (web dashboard, CGNAT relay, analytics, extensions).

download.title: Download DogeGo
download.lead: Pre-built binaries are published on GitHub Releases when tagged. This page checks the same repos as the running node.
download.checkingBody: Querying qlpqlp/dogego, dogeorg/dogego, and dogecoinfoundation/dogego for the latest semver tag.
download.soonBody: No GitHub Release has been published yet on the configured repos. Build from source below, or watch github.com/qlpqlp/dogego for the first tagged release.
download.soonHeroNote: No release published yet - build from source or check back soon.
download.buildCode:
git clone https://github.com/qlpqlp/dogego.git
cd dogego/DogeGo
go build -o dogego ./cmd/dogego
./dogego
download.buildNote: Requires Go 1.22+. App source lives in the DogeGo/ directory; the website is in docs/ at the repo root. On Windows use dogego.exe.

developers.title: Built for developers
developers.lead: Core-compatible JSON-RPC, first-class extensions you can ship yourself, and the full operator docs online and in the app.

openrpc.title: OpenRPC & cookbooks
openrpc.body: Live capability manifest at /api/capabilities, OpenRPC at /api/openrpc.json.

extensions.title: Build extensions
extensions.body: Ship Go or WASM packages with UI panels, RPC (dogego_ext_<id>_*), and optional P2P. Authoring guides live in the catalog. Official packages are listed under Extensions.

docs.title: Full documentation
docs.body: Operator guides, DIPs, extension authoring, and the Bitcoin white paper on the public docs site - the same library as the in-app Docs tab.

zmq.title: ZMQ notifications
zmq.body: Subscribe to hash blocks, hash transactions, raw blocks, and raw transactions.

auth.title: Auth & rate limits
auth.body: Cookie authentication, HTTP basic auth, IP allowlists, and configurable rate limiting.

disclaimer.title: Beta: try it
disclaimer.body: DogeGo is a pure-Go Dogecoin full node with Core-compatible consensus, RPC, wallet migration, and mining. It is beta: please run it on testnet or mainnet, try the workflows you care about, and tell us what needs tuning. Storage uses DogeGo’s native layout (not Core LevelDB); optional long-haul self-cert is in the dashboard Features tab (dogego cert live-soak).

footer.tagline: Much faster full Dogecoin node, written in Go and operated from your browser.
footer.uaNote: Announces as DogeGo on the wire. Not Shibetoshi, not Core. Optional comment: /DogeGo:0.1.0-beta(your-note)/
footer.disclaimer: Mainnet consensus follows Core (no protocol forks). Native Go storage; optional self-cert via Features / dogego cert live-soak.
